_doc: The phone (story 11.3, services/phoneLogic.js, entities/Phone.js): a message arrives when its event `on` fires with a payload that satisfies `match` (equal fields) and `min` (at least); `perDay` lets it arrive once a game day, otherwise once per game. `from` is mom, friend or bully (the taunts of the bully gang tease, they are never nasty). Texts: phone.msg.<id>, senders phone.from.<from>. The inbox keeps the newest `max` messages in the flag phone.inbox.
